name: Ether@Net
detailed_description:
One soul, one human — bound across realms. Her spirit lingers. The truth remains unfinished...

In a haunted city where the dead whisper through neon-lit alleys and forgotten data, you are a Netwalker — a spiritual investigator tethered to both the physical world and a decaying digital ghost realm.

“Ghosts are just unspoken memories. Some stay silent. Others scream through the wires.”

Accompanied by a mysterious female spirit, you’ll uncover the truth behind urban tragedies, investigate cursed locations, and interact with the lost souls trapped between two realms. Equipped with ritual apps, signal-scanning tools, and the forbidden Ether Modem, you’ll cross boundaries no living person should enter.

  • Search for answers in old Hong Kong motels, tenement stairwells, and abandoned chinese village paths.

  • Interview the living. Converse with the dead.

Make choices that matter — for both your world and hers.

Themes & Features

  • 🧿 One Human, One Ghost – Build a unique bond with your spirit partner. Your relationship influences how cases unfold — emotionally and spiritually.

  • 📱 Digital Spiritual Tech – Use ghost-hacking tools, cursed "Hearch" apps, and a haunted data modem to scan, reveal, and decode hidden layers of the world.

  • 🏙️ Urban Paranormal Hong Kong – Explore hyper-detailed, immersive locations based on real HK streets and rural alleyways — reimagined through ghost logic.

  • 🧩 Branching Cases & Multiple Endings – Investigate unsolved disappearances, tragic hauntings, and past regrets — then decide what’s worth saving.

Your Journey.....

In Ether @ Net, every ghost story is tied to a living scar — grief, injustice, loneliness, or guilt.

As a Netwalker, you don’t just solve cases — you walk beside them.

Some spirits seek peace. Others want revenge.

And some… just want someone to listen.

"Will you answer their call?"

Platform & Info

  • 🧭 Platform: Steam (Windows)

  • 👥 Player Mode: Single Player

  • 💀 Genre Tags: Horror, First-Person, Narrative, Mystery, Investigation, Psychological

  • 🎮 Input: Mouse + Keyboard / Controller Supported

  • 🧑‍💻 Developed by: Good Game Show (Hong Kong)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R9 280X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
